sentences.en: They yelled into the classroom and asked whether there was any danger inside of the classroom, anyone with a gun.
sentences.zh: 他们在教室里大喊，询问教室里是否还有危险，有没有人拿着枪。

sentences.en: The students said, no, there wasn't.

sentences.en: And then they fled.
sentences.zh: 然后他们逃了出去。

sentences.en: They fled through a hallway that they described as being lined with SWAT officers,
sentences.zh: 他们穿过一条走廊，据他们描述，走廊两旁站满了特警队员，

sentences.en: And so, that's what, I just remember, like, running for my life.

sentences.zh: 我记得看到警犬在狂吠，然后我才真正反应过来，心想：我要赶紧离开这里。

sentences.en: And I ran from school to Parkland Golf.
sentences.zh: 我从学校一直跑到了帕克兰高尔夫球场。

sentences.en: And I remember.

sentences.en: I thought it looked good for that day, because it was valuable.

sentences.en: I looked so good.

sentences.en: Mm-mm.

sentences.en: In the two weeks since the shooting, they have been spending a lot of time with each other, going to sleepovers, going to memorials.
sentences.zh: 枪击事件发生后的两周里，他们花了很多时间在一起，去参加睡衣派对，去悼念逝者。

sentences.zh: 那天早上我们参加了两个葬礼，接着要去参加卢克（Luke）的遗体瞻仰。

sentences.en: And then we were going to Gina's viewing, what we thought was Gina's viewing.
sentences.zh: 然后我们要去吉娜（Gina）的遗体瞻仰，我们以为那是吉娜的遗体瞻仰。

sentences.en: But instead, we walked in, my best friend and I, we walked in with our moMs.
sentences.zh: 但相反，我和我最好的朋友走进去，我们和妈妈们一起走了进去。

sentences.en: And it was kind of weird, because we were all wearing the pins with the ribbons.
sentences.zh: 这有点奇怪，因为我们都戴着带有缎带的徽章。

sentences.zh: 他们问这些缎带是做什么用的。

sentences.en: And so they were like, oh, that's cool.
sentences.zh: 所以他们就说，哦，那挺酷的。

sentences.en: And then so we walked into the funeral home, and they handed us this card.
sentences.zh: 然后我们走进了殡仪馆，他们递给我们这张卡片。

sentences.zh: 我们本来期望在上面看到吉娜的脸。

sentences.en: But it was this guy named Ron.
sentences.zh: 但上面是一个叫罗恩（Ron）的家伙。

sentences.en: Ronald.
sentences.zh: 罗纳德（Ronald）。

sentences.en: And this old guy here, you can see the picture.
sentences.zh: 还有这里这个老头，你能看到照片。

sentences.en: And we were like, okay, that's not Gina.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就在想，好吧，那不是吉娜。

sentences.en: Yeah, and so we figured out that it was, like, the wrong day.
sentences.zh: 对，然后我们发现，原来是日子记错了。

sentences.en: These girls are pretty resilient.

sentences.en: And they've actually been able to find some light moments in all of this.
sentences.zh: 她们甚至在这一切中找到了一些轻松的时刻。

sentences.en: So now you get to celebrate Ronald.
sentences.zh: 所以现在你们要庆祝罗纳德的生平了。

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: Wait, did you see him?

sentences.zh: 所以当我们交谈时，这些女孩表现得非常镇定，甚至有时还会笑。

sentences.en: But then they are still just, like, tumbled back into that day.

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: I'm happy to take your questions now.
sentences.zh: 我现在很高兴回答你们的问题。

sentences.en: We have a fairly strong manufacturing sector in this community, and I'm pretty sure they'd be happy to hear
sentences.zh: 我们社区拥有相当强大的制造行业，我相信他们会很乐意听到

sentences.en: what your government plans to do on new tariffs announced on aluminum and steel in the south of the border.
sentences.zh: 你们政府计划对美墨边境南部宣布的铝和钢的新关税采取什么行动。

sentences.en: We regard the imposition of any new tariffs or any tariffs on steel or aluminum between our two countries as absolutely unacceptable.
sentences.zh: 我们认为在两国之间征收任何新关税，或对钢铁或铝征收任何关税，都是绝对不可接受的。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, U.S.
sentences.zh: 周末期间，美国

sentences.en: trading partners threatened to retaliate against President Trump's plan for tariffs on imported metals,
sentences.zh: 贸易伙伴威胁要对特朗普总统对进口金属征收关税的计划进行报复，

sentences.en: with tariffs of their own, on everything from American-made motorcycles to bourbon.
sentences.zh: 采取他们自己的关税措施，涵盖从美国制造的摩托车到波旁威士忌的方方面面。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the level of cooperation and integration of our militaries, our defense of North America, and are working together on a broad range of security issues.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的军队合作与一体化水平，我们对北安美的防卫，以及我们在广泛的安全问题上的合作。

sentences.en: In Canada, Prime Minister Justin Trudeau said that Trump's rationale for the tariffs, that imported steel from his country, was a national security threat to the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 在加拿大，总理贾斯廷·特鲁多表示，特朗普对关税的解释——即从该国进口的钢铁是对美国的国家安全威胁——

sentences.en: quote, makes no sense.
sentences.zh: 引用他的话说，“毫无道理”。

sentences.en: I hope the president doesn't really do this, because if he does, it's just going to be a huge tax on American citizens.
sentences.zh: 我希望总统不是来真的，因为如果他这么做，那对美国公民来说将是一笔巨大的税收。

sentences.en: Back in Washington, senators from the president's own party, including Orrin Hatch of Utah and Ben Sasse of Nebraska,
sentences.zh: 回到华盛顿，总统自己党派的参议员，包括来自犹他州的奥林·哈奇和来自内布拉斯加州的本·萨斯，

sentences.en: openly opposed the tariffs, saying they would hurt American consumers by raising the price on goods that use aluminum and steel.
sentences.zh: 公开反对这些关税，称由于提高了使用铝和钢铁的商品的價格，这将损害美国消费者的利益。

sentences.en: If you own a steel mill, today was great for you.
sentences.zh: 如果你拥有一家钢厂，今天对你来说很棒。

sentences.en: If you consume steel and every American family at the store tonight bought something that has different metals in it, today's a bad day for you.
sentences.zh: 如果你消耗钢铁，且今晚在商店里买的每个美国家庭都买了包含不同金属的产品，今天对你来说就是糟糕的一天。

sentences.en: In an interview on Fox News Sunday, the president's chief trade advisor, Peter Navarro, was asked about the criticism from Republicans.
sentences.zh: 在福克斯新闻周日栏目的采访中，总统的首席贸易顾问彼得·纳瓦罗被问及来自共和党的批评。

sentences.en: Are Sasse and Hatch, who is the chair of the Senate Finance Committee, are they wrong?
sentences.zh: 萨斯和担任参议院财政委员会主席的哈奇，他们错了吗？

sentences.en: Of course they're wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们当然错了。

sentences.en: And in terms of the Republican Party, let's remember this.
sentences.zh: 就共和党而言，让我们记住这一点。

sentences.en: Donald Trump ran against 16 Republicans.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普与16位共和党人竞选。

sentences.en: None of those Republicans supported Donald Trump's positions on trade.
sentences.zh: 这些共和党人中没有一个人支持唐纳德·特朗普的贸易立场。

sentences.en: He beat every one of them.
sentences.zh: 他击败了他们每一个人。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为节假日的招待做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有对什么过敏或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上找到《Wirecutter秀》。
